d: The Project Controls Institute (PCI) awards the PCL-AI — one ISO/IEC 17024-aligned credential uniting project controls, cost engineering and project finance, with governed AI at its core.
A single, rigorous credential covering project controls, cost engineering and project finance, with governed AI — built to align with ISO/IEC 17024.
